name: Kakei Kyoutarou
source: The protagonist of the story, an extremely curious guy. Because he made [url=/c2838]Tsugumi[/url] join the library club, it became much noisier and thus he now has less time to read books. Despite that, he and Tsugumi work hard to promote the club's activities. Has excellent grades but is very bad at singing and cooking.
